email.subject: Cool Breeze's site may be losing you calls
email.body:
Hi Kofi,

Quick note on the Cool Breeze Heating & Cooling site. Two things are likely costing you customers: there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors with a broken furnace have to hunt for your number instead of tapping once. And there's no way to book or request service online, so anyone searching after hours just moves to the next HVAC company that lets them.

Also worth fixing when you have time: no customer reviews showing, heavy images slowing the page down, and a page title that doesn't say HVAC or Harbor Falls, which hurts search visibility.

Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what to fix.

Alex
Northlight Web
